design_source: FreeGrasp_B1_选择性路由纠错_实验设计与执行交接_20261002.md (design v1.1)

method.name: constrained route correction R on frozen B1

branches.I: A=direct with identity/direct-grasp evidence risk -> target_first verification
branches.O: A=target_first, unique target, predicted blocked, confidence>=0.75, strong legal relation to that target -> blocker_first planning

method.no_intervention: A=blocker_first always keeps B1 final prediction; no route is ever demoted to direct

data.split: split0 (300 cases, exposed development data; exploratory conclusions only)
data.pairing_key: sceneId + queryObjId + annotation via cases.json case text
data.subset_usage: audit_subset only for stratified reporting, never in policy

models.segmentation: LangSAM sam1 vit_h (frozen repo settings, eghc_mask_repair_v1)
models.prompts: frozen repo route prompts: target_first_evidence_gate_v9_json, hard_blocker_first_v10_json; unchanged

arms.A: frozen repaired A (byte-identical reuse, 0 new calls)

submission_rules.untriggered: byte-identical reuse of frozen A final result (hash-verified)
submission_rules.same_final_id: keep A mask_query/class_name/mask entirely; new reasoning recorded as verification trace
submission_rules.different_valid_id: submit new ID with its own new segmentation text and mask (atomic: ID+text+mask from one output)
submission_rules.segmentation_failure_after_valid_plan: official protocol failure for that row; no post-score fallback to A
submission_rules.technical_failures: transport/auth/unknown-status -> batch stop gate; never silently retried
submission_rules.structural_retry: one pre-registered fresh retry when the prediction returns no usable mask (mirrors resume8 worker)

budget.theoretical_call_ceiling: 31*2 + 7*3 = 83 calls (from real call graph of prior paid batches)
budget.mimo_cost_reporting: token-plan equivalent estimate only; actual plan deduction must be confirmed by user from account records

metrics.engineering_target: +2pp SSR net gain (target, not a prediction)
metrics.iou_threshold_note: official fixed threshold; first-step acceptable GT may include blockers
